newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 70,000 tonnes of durum wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 70,000 tonnes of durum wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 70,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, an official statement issued by the Gecpt said on Friday.
The statement said that an international call for prices fixing September 10 as final date to receive price offers had already been issued.
Confirmation would be made on September 11.
It said the wheat would be for shipment in October.
On August 15 the GECPT issued a similar offer for the sale of 100,000 tonnes of wheat for October delivery. Results were due on September 4 but have not been announced yet.
